name: Quadratic Stress Formulation
description: Replaced the set-theoretic boolean logic conditions with a system of quadratic inequalities over binary variables. By defining a "stress" function that evaluates to 0 or 1 based on the state, the stability condition perfectly encodes a 2-SAT clause. This forces the model to algebraically evaluate the function and recognize the resulting bounded sum as a logical disjunction, defeating models that rely on keyword pattern matching for boolean satisfiability.
